newPrimarySourcesRead.findings: Organiser account of a visit to Ô Parc, Bannay: generic inflatables, swing chairs, zipline, little train, water games and rides. Captions Jeux d’eau, Manège petits, Petit train. None of the three target identities named.
newPrimarySourcesRead.limits: Old embedded media are unresolved scald placeholders on the normal page; no guessed media endpoint or administrative access attempted. Article date is not an attraction opening date.

newPrimarySourcesRead.findings: Organiser account explicitly locates visit at Ô Parc in Bannay. Generic list of giant inflatables, pedal karts, quads, ziplines, swing chairs, games and baby zone. No target identity name.
newPrimarySourcesRead.limits: Image paths have 2023 migration-style dates even though the article is dated 2020. URL path dates must not be used as capture dates. Downloaded jeux picture is only 240×320 and shows a child at a wooden-platform suspended game; no readable attraction name.

newPrimarySourcesRead.findings: Organiser account explicitly identifies Ô Parc at Bannay. Two original images have captions Structure gonflable and Karting. Neither names Twister, octopus or yellow castle.
newPrimarySourcesRead.limits: Event context supports 17 June 2023, not an invented EXIF/precise photo timestamp. Individual photographer and image licence are not supplied.

newPhotographicLeads.observed: Large blue, green, red/orange inflatable arch structure over a circular base, yellow podium blocks, suspended orange/green ball. People stand on the blocks. Blue dome and a large blue slide visible in background. No readable attraction name.
newPhotographicLeads.useLimit: Potential additional photograph of existing La Boule requires root comparison against the already qualified item. It is not independent proof of an alias Twister. No attribution to Twister made. No new photo imported.

newPhotographicLeads.useLimit: Potential illustration of already existing Karts à pédales; a visible brand on one vehicle does not prove a global manufacturer for every vehicle or the circuit. No new photo imported.
